title: Low quality, low-end cookware
text:
Low quality, low-end cookware. This is a 14-piece non-stick aluminum set that includes:

One 5 qt / 4.75 L Covered Dutch Oven
One 2 qt / 1.9 L Covered Saucepan
One 1 qt / 0.95L Covered Saucepan
One 10.25 in / 26 cm Covered Fry Pan (has Thermo-Spot heat indicator)
One 8 in / 20 cm Fry Pan (has Thermo-Spot heat indicator)
One "One Egg Wonder"
4 Plastic Measuring Spoons

The package states these pots have a safe non-stick coating with NO PFOA, NO LEAD, and NO Cadmium. It also indicates that the set can be used on a gas, coil/solid electric, ceramic, or halogen stove. It is made in China and comes with a limited lifetime warranty. I tested my set on a gas stove.

What I like about this set is that it has a large covered fry pan. Most fry pans do not have covers. I also like the brick red color, the handles on the pots, and the tops on the lids which are easy to grip. The pots also wash well. However, I dislike a lot about this cookware.

- The lids do not fit snugly on the large pot or fry pan because the pans are sort of misshaped (not fully circular) causing a gap. The two saucepan covers fit snugly, however.

- The cookware does not hold heat well.

- The 1 qt saucepan easily tips just by touching the handle unless the contents inside are heavy.

- I saw no change in the Thermo- Spot heat indicator of the two fry pans even after heating them up for 5 minutes; so that feature does not work.

- The package says this is oven safe up to 350 degrees (177 C). Personally that is useless to me because I cook at 350 or above. Since many oven temperatures are not exact, it would be easy to go over 350 and the handles would most likely be destroyed.

- For those who use a dishwasher, it says dishwasher safe on the box but the instructions say hand washing is recommended for the non-stick pots.

- The egg I cooked stuck to the non-stick coating of the "one egg wonder" although it did clean up pretty well after soaking.

- The pots also do not stack well because they slip around a lot.

As a side note, since the pots have a non-stick coating, those with pet birds have to be careful using this around them or they could die from the toxicity. The fumes the heated non-stick coating gives off are toxic to birds.

Had I purchased this cookware I would have been extremely upset and sent it back for a refund. This set is just barely serviceable and I cannot recommend this cookware. It is both low end and low quality in my opinion. In fact, I am stunned that others find this cookware favorable to them.
